## Outcome
Done. The pricing bug is fixed, and `npm test` in `/tmp/v3orch/w/t2` now reports 7 pass, 0 fail. That run includes the other subagents' files as they stand at the moment I ran it.

## Changes
- `src/pricing.ts`, `applyDiscount`: changed `Math.round(cents * (1 - pct));` to `Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100));`. The doc comment says `pct` is a whole percentage (`applyDiscount(1000, 10) === 900`), but the code treated it as a fraction, so 10 gave `1 - 10 = -9`. Dividing by 100 makes the doc example return 900.
